en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_desc: Director Voss, unhappy with Borel's progress in dealing with Ferrovald Syndicate, sends Marshal Hale to a small outpost with a very important task.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t1: This desert heat is starting to get to me. I'm too old for this.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t2: Orders said to get here as soon as possible. I wonder what this is all about.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t3: So this is the outpost I'm supposed to command. Does not look like much.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t4: Hello, private. I'm here to take command.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t5: Sir! We've been expecting you. There is a message waiting for you.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t7: Marshal Hale, I hope your trip went fine. Sorry for dispatching you on such short notice, but the situation is getting out of hand and we need your experience.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t8: You must have heard by now that a war broke out in the Aurelian Holdings holdings, with Ferrovald Syndicate invading, and some of our forces got involved.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t9: Commander Vex of the Aurelian Holdings contacted us, asking for help. Ferrovald Syndicate attacked them without notice or reason, driving their army deep into Chairman Aurelian's domain.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t10: Heir Corvin is nowhere to be found. Commander Vex asked us to intervene, and I agreed. It is a great opportunity to both weaken Ferrovald Syndicate and get some favours from Aurelian Holdings, as Commander Vex assured me, that Chairman Aurelian is a generous man.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t11: Or so it seemed... I have ordered Operative Borel to take a large chunk of our forces and deal with the invasion. It didn't work out so well. He tried to cross the Ferrovald Syndicate border and failed.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t12: He did what? That was so foolish of him.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t13: This is where you come in. We still have to assist Aurelian Holdings and reinforce Borel. But before we can do this, we have to rebuild some of our forces. I assign that task to you. The commanding officer of the outpost knows the details.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t14: As usual, Borel rushed forward without much consideration and now needs help.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t15: Sir! I have a list of requirements for you, sent by the director's advisor. Our forces here are lacking in all regards, I'm afraid.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t16: Mechanised forces were taken by Borel on his initial expedition. Only a bare minimum left.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t17: Infantry has been reduced to only this guard unit, and another one up north, near the damaged bridge. Reinforcing them will be our first objective.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t18: We have to recruit more infantry in the Barracks, so that we have at least 5 units in the field, including current ones.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t19: I just noticed, that my active ability isn't available. Looks like air support is lacking in this area.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t20: I still have my passive ability, and it should come in handy. It allows me to recruit Infantry and Mobile Infantry with less AP.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t21: Resources are limited here, so recruitment will take a couple of turns.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t22: New soldiers are ready and eager. We can move on to the next item on the list.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t23: We need at least three teams of Mobile Infantry. They are now available for recruitment in the Barracks.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t24: Another one is done. These units should cover your scouting and support needs.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t25: Only one more to go. Orders are to have at least two Tanks in the field. Factory is waiting for your request.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t27: Do we have further instructions from high command?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t28: Yes Sir we do. You are to take these newly formed forces and proceed to cross the border and provide assistance to any Aurelian Holdings army you encounter.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t29: The bridge over the river has been repaired and should be safe to use.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t30: Send in a scouting party first. I have a bad feeling about this...
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t32: Sir! We have reached the border tower, but it has Ferrovald Syndicate colours! Ferro army is in the area.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t33: Ferrovald Syndicate is already here? They must be controlling Aurelian's lands all the way to the capital. This complicates things.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t34: Scout! Fall back before they spot you.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t35: I think we don't have a choice here. Let's take them head-on.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t36: We should retake this tower and forward Barracks. It will reduce their already limited AP supply.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t37: Our main goal is to take the local HQ.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t39: All units! Regroup at the captured HQ. We will proceed along that road as soon as possible.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t40: I have made a tactical mistake! Fall back!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_desc: During Operative Borel's hasty attack, many units couldn't keep up and were left behind to fend for themselves. It is up to Marshal Hale to reach those soldiers before Ferrovald Syndicate does.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t1: (static) This is an emergency! (crackle) Is anyone out there? We need help!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t2: This is Marshal Hale, we can hear you, just barely. What happened here? Where is Borel?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t3: It's so good to hear you, Sir. We were conducting an assault on Ferrovald Syndicate positions, but it all went south. We lost comms with Operative Borel, he must have pushed through.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t5: We don't know. He went on ahead, we were securing his back, right until we lost comms. After that we got swamped with Ferrovald Syndicate units, and barely managed to fall back to safe positions.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t6: This is a fine mess. What is your current situation?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t7: We are holed up in a forest. Thich bushes provided us cover so far, but we could hear them searching for us, the enemy must be close.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t8: There is a second concealed group way ahead. They have some heavy equipment with them.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t9: We think there are other valuable units hidden somewhere as well.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t10: Ferrovald Syndicate is holding this key town, you have to capture this position if you hope to proceed.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t11: Recon suggested that it is not too heavily fortified.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t12: They appear to be moving north, in order to set up a permanent base there. From the looks of it, it hasn't happened yet, which means they can't reinforce.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t13: That was the good news. The bad news is that we haven't managed to set up camp either. These units are all I have for this mission.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t14: Air support is back up, which means I can call in paratroopers using my Deep Strike ability. Just have to keep in mind, that resources are going to be very limited.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t15: Which means that rescuing those stranded soldiers is my top priority. They will join the fight once one of my units approaches their position.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t16: Finally, destroying all Ferrovald Syndicate forces is essential before we can move on.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t18: I swear I have seen someone over there.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t19: We've been out here for hours, there is no one here. Let's just go back.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t20: You know we can't go back without finding these marauders. Just watch that road.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t21: Hey! I think someone is coming!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t22: Hey, help is here! Starting the engine. Hop on board and we can take you back to the town.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t23: Meridian Combine spotted, and a lot of them! Where did they come from?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t24: That garrison is strong, but we will manage. Just one more fight before this day ends.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t25: So good to see you! We're kinda stuck here. Give us a push and we can help.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t27: Get the engineering crew over here and set up a base. You deserve some rest before we move on.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t28: I wonder what happened with Borel. How could he abandon his troops like that? I have to question him when I have a chance.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t29: Locked and loaded, let's smoke these Ferrovald Syndicate punks.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_desc: A key supply line of the Ferrovald Syndicate army has been located. Meridian Combine must cut it off, to significantly weaken the occupying force, and open the path towards Aurelian Bastion.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t1: The highway looks clear. There are signs of heavy equipment being moved through here recently.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t2: So the reports were accurate then. They are using this route to resupply their forces near Aurelian Bastion.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t3: There are several towers along the road. Looks like they were abandoned by Aurelian Holdings.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t4: Ah, this is great! These towers would allow us to hold the line and cut their logistics.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t5: Any sign of Operative Borel or his troops?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t6: Nothing so far. There is an opening on the other end of this valley, moving in to check it out.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t8: There is a huge Ferrovald Syndicate base, just beyond the canal. It was obscured by the hills.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t9: Ground is destroyed on our end, with signs of battle. Looks like Borel tried to cross the water here, but failed.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t10: We have been detected! We're so lucky they somehow missed us...
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t13: They will probably roll out their units soon.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t14: Heavy equipment is very limited, we couldn't get more through this swamp. Luckily, we have repair crews with us.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t15: We have to capture and hold these towers ASAP.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_o1: Capture the Towers along the highway.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t19: It is, but they can't bring in many Tanks this way. Focusing on Infantry should be a good approach.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t20: Ferrovald Syndicate captured a tower. We need all of them to secure this route.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t21: All towers were captured. Now we have to hold them.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_o3: Hold the Towers along the highway for 5 turns.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t22: Our main force has arrived. I am sure they will realise they can't retake these Towers like that and stop for now. You can take it from here, Sergeant.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t24: As much as I would like to see this through, I mustn't waste any time. If the situation ahead is as bad as it was up till now, I have to find Borel, and fast, before he causes even more trouble.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_desc: Wave after wave of Ferrovald Syndicate attackers are being repelled by Aurelian Holdings soldiers defending the Aurelian Bastion. Marshal Hale commands his troops to capture the Ferro HQ, which also appears to be holding a VIP under guard.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t1: Another group coming! Hold the line!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t2: City is already under attack, but it looks like they can take care of themselves.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t3: We should focus on taking out the Ferrovald Syndicate base.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t4: First of all, we need some production capabilities. Engineers managed to set up a camp, but they were spooked by an enemy Tank and abandoned the site. We just have to claim it.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t5: Ferrovald Syndicate is setting up an artillery unit to hit the city from afar.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t6: Their HQ is located here. It seems they are holding a VIP there as well. I almost expected it would be Operative Borel, but it doesn't look like it.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t7: There is another, smaller base as well. We should take it out before we attempt an attack on the HQ, otherwise we might expose our flank.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_o1: Establish Base in Meridian Combine camp.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_o2: (Optional) Capture the Ferrovald Syndicate forward Camp.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t8: Our forward base has been taken by Meridian Combine!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t9: Send out a call for reinforcements.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t10: Objective complete, Sir. Ferrovald Syndicate soldiers are standing down.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t11: Tell me something, Marchetti. Why has Foundermaster Ferron ordered an attack on Aurelian Holdings's lands? How come, that a lust for conquest overcame his senses?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t12: Pah. What lies. Is that what Commander Vex told you?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t14: It was Aurelian Holdings who attacked us first, without any provocation. It was only fair to strike back.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t15: I might have gotten a bit carried away with that counter-attack, though...
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t16: Hahaha, is that how you ended up behind bars?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t18: Gloat all you want, but it's not me doing dirty work for that tinhead Commander.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t19: These are some serious accusations. I might have to call Director Voss and ask him about that deal he has with Vex...
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t20: Oh, and speaking of tin-heads. Do you know anything about Operative Borel's whereabouts?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t21: You don't know where your own man is? That's hilarious. I've heard he got beaten quite badly while trying to assault Ferronhold. He seems to have disappeared afterward.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t23: Bested by Commander Vex's lackeys. What a shame to see honourable Marshal Hale doing mercenary work.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t24: What are you even talking about? Bring him in for questioning.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t25: Meridian Combine is really pushing on us. We need a more skilled commander.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t27: Are you sure, sir? Foundermaster Ferron might not be happy when he hears about this.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t28: He also won't be happy if we don't stand our ground effectively, since we aren't able to retreat...
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t29: I've heard you summoned me, commander.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t30: The situation is getting difficult, Sir. Marshal Hale arrived not long ago, and he is already giving us a lot of trouble.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t31: My troops need someone a lot more experienced to lead them. I am asking you to take command.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t32: I see. I hate to admit it, but this current predicament might be due to my own making. Even so, I'll do what I can to help.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_desc: Director Voss ordered Marshal Hale to travel east, where Commander Vex requested help in dealing with a new threat. But how could have Ferrovald Syndicate gone that deep into Aurelian Holdings's lands? Or is it something else?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t1: Whew, I think I can take a short break... Vex is really determined to get me. I hope that my father is well.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t2: Thankfully, a call for help I sent to Aurora Concord went through, and they sent some forces to cover my back.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t3: There is another camp not far from here. I can take some proper rest there. I wonder if they brought some of their tropical drinks with them.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t4: Well, well well. If it isn't the cowardly Heir, still on the run.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t5: And Aurora Concord! I didn't expect they would come to his aid. This complicates matters.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t6: Luckily, the reinforcements I ordered from Director Voss are here.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t7: This is Commander Vex, sending an urgent request to Marshal Hale. Aurora Concord has joined the Ferrovald Syndicate in their assault on our holdings. Please assist in clearing their base.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t8: Aurora Concord attacking? Are you sure? They are a peaceful nation. If they are here, it must be for a good reason. Let me talk to their commanding officer.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t9: He's not buying it. I have to tell Voss to send someone more compliant next time. Plan B it is.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t10: Knights, begin your attack on Aurora installations.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t12: Our forces are engaged in combat with Aurora Concord invaders. Please assist!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t13: This is madness. But we still have our orders.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t14: Marshal Hale to Aurelian Holdings forces, we are coming.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t15: There's a temporary Airfield on our flank. I'm sure they are planning to hit us from the side with their air forces. Take it out before going ahead.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t17: General! I beg you to stop!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t18: Heir Corvin? What is going on?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t19: I can explain everything, but not here. Please follow me to my camp. We can talk safely there.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_desc: As Heir Corvin reveals the mastermind behind the invasion, an unexpected guest arrives to crash the party.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t1: So this whole conflict has been caused by Commander Vex so that he can take over Aurelian Holdings?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t2: Yes. And he's been hunting me ever since the initial attack.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t3: What happened with Chairman Aurelian then? Is he a prisoner?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t4: I don't know. No one had seen or heard from the Chairman for weeks, not even me. Vex says, that all of his orders come directly from my father, but I doubt that.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t5: I have to contact the Director immediately. This is not what Meridian Combine signed up for.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t6: So what is your plan, Heir?
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t7: Chancellor Renn is an old friend of my father. I will seek her counsel on what to do.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t8: A wise choice. I wish you good luck on your journey. Excuse me now, I have a lot of work ahead of me if we are to fix this situation.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t9: Thank you, General. Good luck to you as well.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t10: Sergeant, send this encrypted message to Director Voss immediately.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t11: There is an incoming call for you, Sir.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t12: Ah, General. I've got reports you have encountered Heir Corvin. I have some terrible news: Corvin is a traitor, conspiring with Ferrovald Syndicate to overthrow Chairman Aurelian. Your orders are to arrest him at once!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t13: I don't think so. I know that it is you, who is the traitor here. I no longer take orders from you.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t14: What a shame. Well, in that case...
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t15: Stand down, General. You are being relieved of your command. Sergeant, I will be taking over from here.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t16: Is this a joke? You don't have the authority!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t17: Oh, but I do. Here it is, signed by Voss himself. Sergeant, take him away.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t18: You will pay for this, Borel! Corvin, you have to run!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t19: That Vex is getting on my nerves.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t20: Go on, my Heir. We will buy you some time.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t21: These are our lands. We won't let them in.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t22: I hate this so much. I promise you, next time will be different!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t23: I can't let him get away. I must reach that road as quickly as possible.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_o1: Bring Operative Borel to the end of the road.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t25: This is it. All units, follow me!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t26: Sir! Most of our forces are tired and unable to keep up. We have to slow down.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t27: And let the Heir slip away? Fat chance! Now go!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_desc: Just as Aurelian Holdings Heir takes refuge in a Aurora Concord stronghold, Operative Borel plans to infiltrate it and capture Corvin before he slips away.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t1: Finally, I have almost caught up with my target.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t2: The armored corps is here, but those wimpy infantry units didn't manage to keep the pace.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t3: This might prove to be an issue, so deep behind enemy lines, they actually do have quite a lot of troops and buildings.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t4: It seems that a lot of Aurora Concord forces are standing down. They do have radar towers, though. I'm sure, that as soon as I, or any of my units, get too close, they will sound an alarm.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t5: Even if I managed to push through all these defensive lines with my armoured force, I wouldn't be able to hold these positions.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t6: Luckily, I don't have to. All I need to do is to use my awesome Commando abilities, get close to the Heir, and get him out.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t7: Some of the foliage in this area is very dense. I should be able to use it to my advantage. Tall grass will protect me from being detected, as long as the alarm hasn't been activated.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t8: A Rocket Artillery found some old, forgotten route through the wilderness. Normally, it wouldn't do me much good, but thanks to their long range, they can assist from afar.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t9: In the meantime, Aurora Concord might send some units to my encampment. I have to defend it, as it is my only way out.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t10: Corvin isn't going to slip away this time!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t12: No! With that route closed, there is no way for me to get Heir Corvin out of here! This operation is a bust.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t13: Almost there. All I have to do is to approach the target and grab him!
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t14: There is a guard ahead. They will spot me if I just try to sneak around the tree line.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t15: I have to take them out somehow. Or I could just wait a bit and use my skill to get across those trees undetected.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t16: Treeline is thinner here. I should be able to get through it using my Infiltration skill.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t17: I'm pretty sure they will still spot me though. Enemy units might go after me into the tall grass to investigate, but shouldn't raise an alarm just yet. In that case, I should just keep going.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t20: Surrender, you have nowhere to run now.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t21: I warned you, that the next time we meet it will be different. I won't run away anymore.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t24: Borel is a master infiltrator. We probably wouldn't be able to catch him anyway. Just let him run, he won't be able to pester you anymore.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t25: Our transport to the Halcyon Atoll is waiting. Let's go.
en.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t26: Another guard, this time on patrol. They could be taken out, or I could just wait for them to get around the corner and run.

pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_desc: Director Voss, unhappy with Borel's progress in dealing with Ferrovald Syndicate, sends Marshal Hale to a small outpost with a very important task.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t1: This desert heat is starting to get to me. I'm too old for this.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t2: Orders said to get here as soon as possible. I wonder what this is all about.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t3: So this is the outpost I'm supposed to command. Does not look like much.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t4: Hello, private. I'm here to take command.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t5: Sir! We've been expecting you. There is a message waiting for you.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t7: Marshal Hale, I hope your trip went fine. Sorry for dispatching you on such short notice, but the situation is getting out of hand and we need your experience.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t8: You must have heard by now that a war broke out in the Aurelian Holdings holdings, with Ferrovald Syndicate invading, and some of our forces got involved.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t9: Commander Vex of the Aurelian Holdings contacted us, asking for help. Ferrovald Syndicate attacked them without notice or reason, driving their army deep into Chairman Aurelian's domain.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t10: Heir Corvin is nowhere to be found. Commander Vex asked us to intervene, and I agreed. It is a great opportunity to both weaken Ferrovald Syndicate and get some favours from Aurelian Holdings, as Commander Vex assured me, that Chairman Aurelian is a generous man.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t11: Or so it seemed... I have ordered Operative Borel to take a large chunk of our forces and deal with the invasion. It didn't work out so well. He tried to cross the Ferrovald Syndicate border and failed.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t12: He did what? That was so foolish of him.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t13: This is where you come in. We still have to assist Aurelian Holdings and reinforce Borel. But before we can do this, we have to rebuild some of our forces. I assign that task to you. The commanding officer of the outpost knows the details.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t14: As usual, Borel rushed forward without much consideration and now needs help.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t15: Sir! I have a list of requirements for you, sent by the director's advisor. Our forces here are lacking in all regards, I'm afraid.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t16: Mechanised forces were taken by Borel on his initial expedition. Only a bare minimum left.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t17: Infantry has been reduced to only this guard unit, and another one up north, near the damaged bridge. Reinforcing them will be our first objective.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t18: We have to recruit more infantry in the Barracks, so that we have at least 5 units in the field, including current ones.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t19: I just noticed, that my active ability isn't available. Looks like air support is lacking in this area.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t20: I still have my passive ability, and it should come in handy. It allows me to recruit Infantry and Mobile Infantry with less AP.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t21: Resources are limited here, so recruitment will take a couple of turns.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t22: New soldiers are ready and eager. We can move on to the next item on the list.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t23: We need at least three teams of Mobile Infantry. They are now available for recruitment in the Barracks.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t24: Another one is done. These units should cover your scouting and support needs.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t25: Only one more to go. Orders are to have at least two Tanks in the field. Factory is waiting for your request.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t27: Do we have further instructions from high command?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t28: Yes Sir we do. You are to take these newly formed forces and proceed to cross the border and provide assistance to any Aurelian Holdings army you encounter.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t29: The bridge over the river has been repaired and should be safe to use.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t30: Send in a scouting party first. I have a bad feeling about this...
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t32: Sir! We have reached the border tower, but it has Ferrovald Syndicate colours! Ferro army is in the area.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t33: Ferrovald Syndicate is already here? They must be controlling Aurelian's lands all the way to the capital. This complicates things.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t34: Scout! Fall back before they spot you.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t35: I think we don't have a choice here. Let's take them head-on.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t36: We should retake this tower and forward Barracks. It will reduce their already limited AP supply.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t37: Our main goal is to take the local HQ.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t39: All units! Regroup at the captured HQ. We will proceed along that road as soon as possible.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m1_t40: I have made a tactical mistake! Fall back!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_desc: During Operative Borel's hasty attack, many units couldn't keep up and were left behind to fend for themselves. It is up to Marshal Hale to reach those soldiers before Ferrovald Syndicate does.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t1: (static) This is an emergency! (crackle) Is anyone out there? We need help!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t2: This is Marshal Hale, we can hear you, just barely. What happened here? Where is Borel?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t3: It's so good to hear you, Sir. We were conducting an assault on Ferrovald Syndicate positions, but it all went south. We lost comms with Operative Borel, he must have pushed through.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t5: We don't know. He went on ahead, we were securing his back, right until we lost comms. After that we got swamped with Ferrovald Syndicate units, and barely managed to fall back to safe positions.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t6: This is a fine mess. What is your current situation?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t7: We are holed up in a forest. Thich bushes provided us cover so far, but we could hear them searching for us, the enemy must be close.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t8: There is a second concealed group way ahead. They have some heavy equipment with them.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t9: We think there are other valuable units hidden somewhere as well.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t10: Ferrovald Syndicate is holding this key town, you have to capture this position if you hope to proceed.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t11: Recon suggested that it is not too heavily fortified.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t12: They appear to be moving north, in order to set up a permanent base there. From the looks of it, it hasn't happened yet, which means they can't reinforce.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t13: That was the good news. The bad news is that we haven't managed to set up camp either. These units are all I have for this mission.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t14: Air support is back up, which means I can call in paratroopers using my Deep Strike ability. Just have to keep in mind, that resources are going to be very limited.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t15: Which means that rescuing those stranded soldiers is my top priority. They will join the fight once one of my units approaches their position.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t16: Finally, destroying all Ferrovald Syndicate forces is essential before we can move on.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t18: I swear I have seen someone over there.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t19: We've been out here for hours, there is no one here. Let's just go back.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t20: You know we can't go back without finding these marauders. Just watch that road.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t21: Hey! I think someone is coming!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t22: Hey, help is here! Starting the engine. Hop on board and we can take you back to the town.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t23: Meridian Combine spotted, and a lot of them! Where did they come from?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t24: That garrison is strong, but we will manage. Just one more fight before this day ends.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t25: So good to see you! We're kinda stuck here. Give us a push and we can help.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t27: Get the engineering crew over here and set up a base. You deserve some rest before we move on.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t28: I wonder what happened with Borel. How could he abandon his troops like that? I have to question him when I have a chance.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m2_t29: Locked and loaded, let's smoke these Ferrovald Syndicate punks.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_desc: A key supply line of the Ferrovald Syndicate army has been located. Meridian Combine must cut it off, to significantly weaken the occupying force, and open the path towards Aurelian Bastion.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t1: The highway looks clear. There are signs of heavy equipment being moved through here recently.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t2: So the reports were accurate then. They are using this route to resupply their forces near Aurelian Bastion.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t3: There are several towers along the road. Looks like they were abandoned by Aurelian Holdings.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t4: Ah, this is great! These towers would allow us to hold the line and cut their logistics.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t5: Any sign of Operative Borel or his troops?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t6: Nothing so far. There is an opening on the other end of this valley, moving in to check it out.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t8: There is a huge Ferrovald Syndicate base, just beyond the canal. It was obscured by the hills.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t9: Ground is destroyed on our end, with signs of battle. Looks like Borel tried to cross the water here, but failed.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t10: We have been detected! We're so lucky they somehow missed us...
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t13: They will probably roll out their units soon.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t14: Heavy equipment is very limited, we couldn't get more through this swamp. Luckily, we have repair crews with us.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t15: We have to capture and hold these towers ASAP.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_o1: Capture the Towers along the highway.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t19: It is, but they can't bring in many Tanks this way. Focusing on Infantry should be a good approach.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t20: Ferrovald Syndicate captured a tower. We need all of them to secure this route.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t21: All towers were captured. Now we have to hold them.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_o3: Hold the Towers along the highway for 5 turns.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t22: Our main force has arrived. I am sure they will realise they can't retake these Towers like that and stop for now. You can take it from here, Sergeant.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m3_t24: As much as I would like to see this through, I mustn't waste any time. If the situation ahead is as bad as it was up till now, I have to find Borel, and fast, before he causes even more trouble.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_desc: Wave after wave of Ferrovald Syndicate attackers are being repelled by Aurelian Holdings soldiers defending the Aurelian Bastion. Marshal Hale commands his troops to capture the Ferro HQ, which also appears to be holding a VIP under guard.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t1: Another group coming! Hold the line!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t2: City is already under attack, but it looks like they can take care of themselves.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t3: We should focus on taking out the Ferrovald Syndicate base.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t4: First of all, we need some production capabilities. Engineers managed to set up a camp, but they were spooked by an enemy Tank and abandoned the site. We just have to claim it.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t5: Ferrovald Syndicate is setting up an artillery unit to hit the city from afar.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t6: Their HQ is located here. It seems they are holding a VIP there as well. I almost expected it would be Operative Borel, but it doesn't look like it.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t7: There is another, smaller base as well. We should take it out before we attempt an attack on the HQ, otherwise we might expose our flank.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_o1: Establish Base in Meridian Combine camp.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_o2: (Optional) Capture the Ferrovald Syndicate forward Camp.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t8: Our forward base has been taken by Meridian Combine!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t9: Send out a call for reinforcements.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t10: Objective complete, Sir. Ferrovald Syndicate soldiers are standing down.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t11: Tell me something, Marchetti. Why has Foundermaster Ferron ordered an attack on Aurelian Holdings's lands? How come, that a lust for conquest overcame his senses?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t12: Pah. What lies. Is that what Commander Vex told you?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t14: It was Aurelian Holdings who attacked us first, without any provocation. It was only fair to strike back.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t15: I might have gotten a bit carried away with that counter-attack, though...
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t16: Hahaha, is that how you ended up behind bars?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t18: Gloat all you want, but it's not me doing dirty work for that tinhead Commander.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t19: These are some serious accusations. I might have to call Director Voss and ask him about that deal he has with Vex...
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t20: Oh, and speaking of tin-heads. Do you know anything about Operative Borel's whereabouts?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t21: You don't know where your own man is? That's hilarious. I've heard he got beaten quite badly while trying to assault Ferronhold. He seems to have disappeared afterward.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t23: Bested by Commander Vex's lackeys. What a shame to see honourable Marshal Hale doing mercenary work.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t24: What are you even talking about? Bring him in for questioning.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t25: Meridian Combine is really pushing on us. We need a more skilled commander.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t27: Are you sure, sir? Foundermaster Ferron might not be happy when he hears about this.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t28: He also won't be happy if we don't stand our ground effectively, since we aren't able to retreat...
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t29: I've heard you summoned me, commander.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t30: The situation is getting difficult, Sir. Marshal Hale arrived not long ago, and he is already giving us a lot of trouble.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t31: My troops need someone a lot more experienced to lead them. I am asking you to take command.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m4_t32: I see. I hate to admit it, but this current predicament might be due to my own making. Even so, I'll do what I can to help.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_desc: Director Voss ordered Marshal Hale to travel east, where Commander Vex requested help in dealing with a new threat. But how could have Ferrovald Syndicate gone that deep into Aurelian Holdings's lands? Or is it something else?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t1: Whew, I think I can take a short break... Vex is really determined to get me. I hope that my father is well.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t2: Thankfully, a call for help I sent to Aurora Concord went through, and they sent some forces to cover my back.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t3: There is another camp not far from here. I can take some proper rest there. I wonder if they brought some of their tropical drinks with them.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t4: Well, well well. If it isn't the cowardly Heir, still on the run.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t5: And Aurora Concord! I didn't expect they would come to his aid. This complicates matters.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t6: Luckily, the reinforcements I ordered from Director Voss are here.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t7: This is Commander Vex, sending an urgent request to Marshal Hale. Aurora Concord has joined the Ferrovald Syndicate in their assault on our holdings. Please assist in clearing their base.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t8: Aurora Concord attacking? Are you sure? They are a peaceful nation. If they are here, it must be for a good reason. Let me talk to their commanding officer.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t9: He's not buying it. I have to tell Voss to send someone more compliant next time. Plan B it is.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t10: Knights, begin your attack on Aurora installations.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t12: Our forces are engaged in combat with Aurora Concord invaders. Please assist!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t13: This is madness. But we still have our orders.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t14: Marshal Hale to Aurelian Holdings forces, we are coming.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t15: There's a temporary Airfield on our flank. I'm sure they are planning to hit us from the side with their air forces. Take it out before going ahead.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t17: General! I beg you to stop!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t18: Heir Corvin? What is going on?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m5_t19: I can explain everything, but not here. Please follow me to my camp. We can talk safely there.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_desc: As Heir Corvin reveals the mastermind behind the invasion, an unexpected guest arrives to crash the party.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t1: So this whole conflict has been caused by Commander Vex so that he can take over Aurelian Holdings?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t2: Yes. And he's been hunting me ever since the initial attack.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t3: What happened with Chairman Aurelian then? Is he a prisoner?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t4: I don't know. No one had seen or heard from the Chairman for weeks, not even me. Vex says, that all of his orders come directly from my father, but I doubt that.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t5: I have to contact the Director immediately. This is not what Meridian Combine signed up for.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t6: So what is your plan, Heir?
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t7: Chancellor Renn is an old friend of my father. I will seek her counsel on what to do.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t8: A wise choice. I wish you good luck on your journey. Excuse me now, I have a lot of work ahead of me if we are to fix this situation.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t9: Thank you, General. Good luck to you as well.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t10: Sergeant, send this encrypted message to Director Voss immediately.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t11: There is an incoming call for you, Sir.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t12: Ah, General. I've got reports you have encountered Heir Corvin. I have some terrible news: Corvin is a traitor, conspiring with Ferrovald Syndicate to overthrow Chairman Aurelian. Your orders are to arrest him at once!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t13: I don't think so. I know that it is you, who is the traitor here. I no longer take orders from you.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t14: What a shame. Well, in that case...
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t15: Stand down, General. You are being relieved of your command. Sergeant, I will be taking over from here.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t16: Is this a joke? You don't have the authority!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t17: Oh, but I do. Here it is, signed by Voss himself. Sergeant, take him away.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t18: You will pay for this, Borel! Corvin, you have to run!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t19: That Vex is getting on my nerves.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t20: Go on, my Heir. We will buy you some time.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t21: These are our lands. We won't let them in.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t22: I hate this so much. I promise you, next time will be different!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t23: I can't let him get away. I must reach that road as quickly as possible.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_o1: Bring Operative Borel to the end of the road.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t25: This is it. All units, follow me!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t26: Sir! Most of our forces are tired and unable to keep up. We have to slow down.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m6_t27: And let the Heir slip away? Fat chance! Now go!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_desc: Just as Aurelian Holdings Heir takes refuge in a Aurora Concord stronghold, Operative Borel plans to infiltrate it and capture Corvin before he slips away.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t1: Finally, I have almost caught up with my target.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t2: The armored corps is here, but those wimpy infantry units didn't manage to keep the pace.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t3: This might prove to be an issue, so deep behind enemy lines, they actually do have quite a lot of troops and buildings.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t4: It seems that a lot of Aurora Concord forces are standing down. They do have radar towers, though. I'm sure, that as soon as I, or any of my units, get too close, they will sound an alarm.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t5: Even if I managed to push through all these defensive lines with my armoured force, I wouldn't be able to hold these positions.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t6: Luckily, I don't have to. All I need to do is to use my awesome Commando abilities, get close to the Heir, and get him out.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t7: Some of the foliage in this area is very dense. I should be able to use it to my advantage. Tall grass will protect me from being detected, as long as the alarm hasn't been activated.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t8: A Rocket Artillery found some old, forgotten route through the wilderness. Normally, it wouldn't do me much good, but thanks to their long range, they can assist from afar.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t9: In the meantime, Aurora Concord might send some units to my encampment. I have to defend it, as it is my only way out.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t10: Corvin isn't going to slip away this time!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t12: No! With that route closed, there is no way for me to get Heir Corvin out of here! This operation is a bust.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t13: Almost there. All I have to do is to approach the target and grab him!
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t14: There is a guard ahead. They will spot me if I just try to sneak around the tree line.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t15: I have to take them out somehow. Or I could just wait a bit and use my skill to get across those trees undetected.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t16: Treeline is thinner here. I should be able to get through it using my Infiltration skill.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t17: I'm pretty sure they will still spot me though. Enemy units might go after me into the tall grass to investigate, but shouldn't raise an alarm just yet. In that case, I should just keep going.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t20: Surrender, you have nowhere to run now.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t21: I warned you, that the next time we meet it will be different. I won't run away anymore.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t24: Borel is a master infiltrator. We probably wouldn't be able to catch him anyway. Just let him run, he won't be able to pester you anymore.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t25: Our transport to the Halcyon Atoll is waiting. Let's go.
pl.tr_core_sapphire_dawn_m7_t26: Another guard, this time on patrol. They could be taken out, or I could just wait for them to get around the corner and run.
